detail: Directed adjudication fix: next CI pytest packet captures and publishes diagnosis.failures (stable FAILED node IDs) and diagnosis.first_error from the transcript. Root causes established from run 33463923780: nested Groundtruth checkout contaminated failure-ID scan; local hook path was not installed; reviewed archive commit 7bbbc9d was absent from CI object store. This commit moves Groundtruth outside harness scan, runs .githooks/install locally, fetches the immutable fixture object, preserves full pytest and explicit exit status.
